dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 02, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
"Flaherty and Tigers Shut Down Rays in Dominant 8-0 Victory"

Detroit's Jack Flaherty turned in a stellar performance, going 5 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs to lead the Tigers to an 8-0 shutout of the Tampa Bay Rays. On the offense, Wenceel Pérez hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs, while Riley Greene added a solo homer of his own. Pérez's 2-home-run performance led the Tigers' offense, which exploded for 8 runs on 9 hits.

In other action, the Philadelphia Phillies edged the San Diego Padres 3-2 behind a strong outing from Aaron Nola, who struck out 8 over 5 innings. Gavin Sheets provided the go-ahead run with a 2-run homer. Bryce Harper and Brandon Marsh also had key contributions for the Phillies.

The Atlanta Braves took down the Toronto Blue Jays 4-3, with Kazuma Okamoto hitting a solo homer and driving in 2 runs. Bryce Elder earned the win, striking out 6 over 6 innings.
